facility.name: Ivy Kids of Coit
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 300 N COIT RD, MCKINNEY, TX, 75071

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Two out of ten caregiver files reviwed had CPR/First Aid training certificates which indicated that the courses were taken online and not in person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Bleach-based cleaning spray was located accessible to children next a child handwashing sink in a classroom caring for three year old children. The Director moved the cleaning spray to a location not accessible to children when this was discovered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director did not ensure that the minimum standard for reporting standards violations to CCR was followed despite being aware of situations in which a report to CCR would be required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not make a report to CCR regarding children being grabbed or pulled by a caregiver while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Caregivers at the operation were found to have grabbed or pulled children in care in multiple incidents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The permit holder did not ensure that the minimum standard for reporting standards violations to CCR was followed despite being aware of situations in which a report to CCR would be required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver was found to have yelled at children under the age of three while caring for them at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and was found to be deficient. The operation did not make a self-report to Child Care Regulation when water from a leaky roof entered a room, when water entered another room through the back door/wall of the room, and when moisture was discovered in a wall of a room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence (26 TAC §746.305(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The parent handbook was missing a Parent rights statement that included all the items listed in standard 746.521.  This was corrected at inspection when the director updated the parent handbook and emailed the new parent handbook to the parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and was found to be deficient. Through review of video and interviews with children and staff, it was determined a caregiver was not properly supervising the children in care who were using a large basketball game that had two basketball hoops and folding legs. The caregiver was not close to the basketball game and did not intervene to prevent the children from crowding around and leaning on the game which caused the legs to unfold and the equipment to fall. The top of the game hit a child, which caused minor injuries to the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During the walkthrough of the facility, an infant was observed sleeping in a swing. The caregiver stated the infant had been asleep for ten minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: During the walkthrough of the facility, a caregiver was observed placing an infant on their stomach to sleep in their crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: During the investigation, video footage was reviewed which showed that a caregiver grabbed two children by the arms and pulled them up and away from a group after the two children were playing on the ground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation it was determined that a caregiver pinched a child leaving a bruise indicating that substantial force was used to cause the injury. The caregiver was also observed by multiple individuals hitting children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation it was determined that a child was abused while in care at the operation by a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Harsh, Abusive or Profane Language: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation it was determined that a caregiver used profane language while instructing children to return to their seats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation it was determined that a caregiver was using their phone for personal use while supervising children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation, video evidence shows a caregiver pulling a child roughly by the arm and forcefully moving them across the room by their arms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation it was determined that a caregiver was observed by multiple persons to be yelling at children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Child Care Center Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit: A caregiver did not have a notarized affidavit on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on interviews with the parent and the staff, the operation was found not to be in compliance with the minimum standards for licensed childcare centers.  A child was left alone in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Based on interviews with management/ staff and a parent, a parent was not notified a child sustained a finger injury that occurred at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on interviews with the staff, the operation was found not to be in compliance with the standard.    A child was left alone unsupervised in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: The operation was found not to be in compliance with the standard evaluated.  Based on interviews with staff, a caregiver aggressively yells at young children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: The operation was found not to be in compliance with the standard that was evaluated.   Based on interviews with staff, a caregiver threatens to use corporal punishment with children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments: The operation was found not to be in compliance with the standard that was evaluated.   Based on interviews with staff, management allowed a caregiver that does did not exhibit the ability to work with a young children continued to be placed in charge of the young age-group which resulted in the caregiver using inappropriate voice tones and using threats of corporal punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments (26 TAC §746.1003(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver supervised 17 young children with the specified age-group of 3 years.  The ratio is 15 to 1.  The deficiency was corrected during the inspection when a second caregiver transitioned into the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Gas Leak Inspection - Natural Gas: The operation does not have a current gas inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Gas Leak Inspection - Natural Gas (26 TAC §746.5403(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not conducted a fire drill since October 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: This standard was evaluated during the investigation and was found to be deficient. A caregiver pulled a child's arm in a harsh manner as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
